name: Pixel painting
description: Paint a picture with both handles: It reads colours, Me paints where It is. Colours by voice, "recognize" turns outlines into rails; level 2 lets It trace a colour, level 3 has a finer grid, level 4 recognizes freehand shapes.

levels.name: Canvas
levels.intro: Canvas. Bring Me to It to paint. Say a colour, erase or recognize.

levels.name: Trace
levels.intro: Trace. Paint, then say show red or recognize to feel it.

levels.name: Fine canvas
Feelable shapes
levels.intro: Feelable shapes. Say start drawing, draw with Me, then say stop drawing.
